offering_description.value: Grows, processes and packages canned, frozen and packaged fruits and vegetables. Sells to retailers, foodservice, food manufacturers, the US government and consumers, under its own brands, private labels and contract packing.

primary_products.value: canned vegetables; canned fruit; frozen vegetables; fruit snacks and chip products; private label packaged foods

customer_segment.value: B2B: supermarket chains (private label), foodservice distributors, food manufacturers, mass merchants; B2G: US Department of Agriculture and school nutrition programs; B2C: consumers buying branded products via retail

end_markets.value: grocery retail; foodservice; school nutrition; food manufacturing; export

revenue_model.value: product sales: canned and frozen fruits and vegetables, snacks sold to retailers, foodservice, government; service fees: contract packing for other food brands

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes crops from growers and company farms into packaged foods sold to retailers and foodservice; brand owner: owns regional and licensed consumer food brands sold through grocery retail

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US nationwide, with export sales to international customers

specialization.value: related lines: canned vegetables, canned fruit, frozen vegetables and snack products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: retail chains, food manufacturers, foodservice and government buyers; agents / brokers: food brokers representing retail and foodservice accounts; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety rules under FDA and USDA, plus environmental and wastewater regulations
